slip.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the entrance.
slip.zh: 入口附近地板濕滑，小心不要滑倒。

slipper.en: One slipper was left beside the bed in the guest room.
slipper.zh: 客房床邊留著一隻拖鞋。

slippery.en: The path becomes slippery after heavy rain, so signs warn visitors.
slippery.zh: 大雨後步道會變滑，因此有標示提醒遊客。

slogan.en: The campaign used a short slogan that students could remember easily.
slogan.zh: 這項活動使用一句學生容易記住的簡短口號。

slope.en: The bicycle path follows a gentle slope toward the river.
slope.zh: 自行車道沿著緩坡通往河邊。

sloppy.en: The teacher asked him to revise the sloppy first draft.
sloppy.zh: 老師要他修改那份草率的初稿。

slot.en: Each group received a ten-minute slot for its presentation.
slot.zh: 每組都分配到十分鐘的報告時段。

slow.en: A slow internet connection delayed the online lesson this morning.
slow.zh: 今天早上網路速度慢，延誤了線上課程。

slum.en: The documentary examines housing conditions in an urban slum.
slum.zh: 紀錄片探討都市貧民區的居住條件。

slump.en: Sales entered a slump after demand dropped during winter.
slump.zh: 冬季需求下降後，銷售陷入低迷。

sly.en: The fox in the story is clever and slightly sly.
sly.zh: 故事中的狐狸聰明又有點狡猾。

smart.en: Using a checklist is a smart way to avoid missing tasks.
smart.zh: 使用檢查表是避免漏掉任務的好方法。

smog.en: Heavy smog reduced visibility across the city that morning.
smog.zh: 那天早上濃霧霾使城市能見度降低。

smoke.en: Smoke from a distant fire drifted across the valley.
smoke.zh: 遠處火災的煙飄過山谷。

smooth.en: The polished stone has a smooth surface that reflects light.
smooth.zh: 拋光石頭表面光滑，會反射光線。

snack.en: She packed a healthy snack for the afternoon study session.
snack.zh: 她為下午讀書時間準備了一份健康點心。

snail.en: A small snail moved slowly across the garden path.
snail.zh: 一隻小蝸牛慢慢爬過花園小徑。

snake.en: The biology book explains how a snake senses its surroundings.
snake.zh: 生物課本說明蛇如何感知周遭環境。

snap.en: The photographer waited for the right moment to snap the picture.
snap.zh: 攝影師等到適當時機才拍下照片。

sneak.en: The cat tried to sneak past the open classroom door.
sneak.zh: 那隻貓試著悄悄溜過開著的教室門。

sneaker.en: A wet sneaker was drying beside the locker after practice.
sneaker.zh: 練習後，一隻濕球鞋放在置物櫃旁晾乾。

sneaky.en: The character uses a sneaky trick to avoid doing his chores.
sneaky.zh: 那個角色用狡猾的小把戲逃避做家事。

sneeze.en: A sudden sneeze interrupted the quiet reading period.
sneeze.zh: 突然一聲噴嚏打斷了安靜閱讀時間。

sniff.en: The dog began to sniff around the new backpack.
sniff.zh: 那隻狗開始在新背包周圍聞來聞去。

snore.en: The comedy scene shows a character beginning to snore on the bus.
snore.zh: 喜劇場景中，一名角色在公車上開始打呼。

snow.en: Fresh snow covered the mountain trail overnight.
snow.zh: 新下的雪一夜之間覆蓋了山間步道。

snowy.en: The snowy landscape looked bright under the morning sun.
snowy.zh: 白雪覆蓋的景色在晨光下看起來很明亮。

so.en: The room was noisy, so we moved the discussion outside.
so.zh: 房間太吵，所以我們把討論移到外面。

soak.en: The rain began to soak our bags before we reached shelter.
soak.zh: 我們到達遮蔽處前，雨已開始把背包淋濕。

soap.en: The sink has soap beside it for washing hands.
soap.zh: 洗手台旁放有肥皂供洗手使用。

soar.en: Eagles can soar high above the valley on warm air currents.
soar.zh: 老鷹可以乘著暖氣流高高翱翔在山谷上空。

soccer.en: The students played soccer on the field after class.
soccer.zh: 學生下課後在球場踢足球。

sociable.en: Her sociable nature helped new classmates feel welcome.
sociable.zh: 她合群的個性讓新同學感到受到歡迎。

socialism.en: The history course introduces socialism as one major political idea.
socialism.zh: 歷史課把社會主義介紹為一種重要政治思想。

socialist.en: The textbook compares a socialist party with other historical movements.
socialist.zh: 課本比較一個社會主義政黨與其他歷史運動。

socialize.en: The club gives students a chance to socialize after school.
socialize.zh: 社團讓學生放學後有機會與人互動。

sociology.en: Sociology examines how people and groups interact in society.
sociology.zh: 社會學研究人們與群體如何在社會中互動。

sock.en: One clean sock was missing from the laundry basket.
sock.zh: 洗衣籃裡少了一隻乾淨襪子。

sponsor.en: A local company agreed to sponsor the school science fair.
sponsor.zh: 一家當地公司同意贊助學校科展。

sponsorship.en: The event received sponsorship from several community organizations.
sponsorship.zh: 這項活動獲得數個社區組織的贊助。

spoon.en: She used a spoon to stir the soup before lunch.
spoon.zh: 午餐前，她用湯匙攪拌湯。

sport.en: Swimming is the sport he enjoys most during summer.
sport.zh: 游泳是他夏天最喜歡的運動。

sportsman.en: The biography describes him as a dedicated sportsman and coach.
sportsman.zh: 這本傳記把他描述為投入的運動員與教練。

sportsmanship.en: Good sportsmanship matters even when a team loses a close game.
sportsmanship.zh: 即使球隊在激烈比賽中落敗，良好運動精神仍很重要。

sportswoman.en: The article profiles a sportswoman who represented her school nationally.
sportswoman.zh: 文章介紹一位代表學校參加全國賽的女運動員。

spot.en: We found a quiet spot beside the window for reading.
spot.zh: 我們在窗邊找到一個安靜的閱讀位置。

spotlight.en: The student stepped into the spotlight before beginning her speech.
spotlight.zh: 那位學生走到聚光燈下後開始演講。

spouse.en: The form includes space for a spouse's contact information.
spouse.zh: 這張表格有填寫配偶聯絡資料的欄位。

spread.en: Clear communication can spread useful information quickly through a school.
spread.zh: 清楚溝通可以讓有用資訊迅速傳遍校園。

spring.en: The garden becomes colorful when spring arrives each year.
spring.zh: 每年春天到來時，花園就變得色彩繽紛。
